displayDescription: A glowing idea block grows, cube by cube, into a lit, connected voxel system on a night-slate isometric stage.
styleRenderer: custom GLSL ShaderMaterial (flat key light, local light pool, edge lines)
motionEngine: GSAP paused timeline (window.__timelines.video) owning scene time and copy tweens
limitations: The lighting is an authored shader approximation: one fixed key light, ambient light, a falloff-only warm point pool and a glow term. There are no shadows, global illumination or physically based materials.
Block edges are drawn per face from UVs, so they are not geometric bevels.
The background is scene-dependent: the palette foreground slate #30444C is used as a night stage, chosen from the source-frame review. It is not the earlier cream swatch.
SYSTEM is set in cream rather than teal, because teal against both cream and slate measures below 3:1. Teal is kept as the SYSTEM rule and the path blocks.
No reviewed preview recipe was supplied, so none is demonstrated.
three.js may call Math.random only to generate internal object UUIDs. This does not affect pixels.
Not rendered or browser-tested by the agent. Host QA is pending.
